以本課決策條件作有條件結論：建立產生率、未讀偏移、檔案輪替及保留時間表，不能只看代理程序仍在運作就推定無遺失。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 來源保留時間必須覆蓋停機加追趕時間；記憶體上限與檔案保留是不同資源邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Source retention must cover outage plus catch-up; memory limits and source-file lifetime are distinct resource boundaries.

stages.title: 來源生命週期
stages.description: Fluent Bit不同輸入的暫停行為不同；本課研究檔案tail暫停後，原始檔是否仍留在磁碟可供續讀。 建立產生率、未讀偏移、檔案輪替及保留時間表，不能只看代理程序仍在運作就推定無遺失。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 把檔案世代、來源offset、產生秒與已讀offset寫入tail-ledger.csv。輪替後即使檔名重用也建立新世代，避免把新檔案offset當成舊檔續讀。教學速率用十進位MB/s，另在metadata註記這不是Fluent Bit內部chunk大小。
stages.descriptionEn: Fluent Bit inputs respond differently to pausing; examine whether a tailed file remains available when ingestion resumes. Track generation rate, unread offsets, rotation and retention; a running agent alone does not establish lossless collection. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Write file generation, source offset, production second and read offset into tail-ledger.csv. A rotated file receives a new generation even if its pathname is reused, preventing a new-file offset from masquerading as continuation of the old file. Use decimal MB/s and state that the modeled byte rate is not Fluent Bit internal chunk sizing.
